mechanism_narrative: A declining unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates improving labor market conditions, which boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of periods when UNRATE declines, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) below 0.5% and declining for three months signals aggressive monetary easing, which compresses discount rates and supports equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in residential sales (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicates a collapse in housing demand, which reduces consumer confidence and corporate revenue growth, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a low-industrial-production regime (INDPRO < 90), a decline in INDPRO signals worsening supply chain conditions and economic contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of periods when INDPRO is below 90 and declining, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 85, it signals severe economic contraction, triggering a sell-off in equities and producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising residential sales figure (RSAFS) indicates improving consumer demand for housing, which boosts consumer confidence and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of periods when RSAFS rises, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a near-zero interest rate regime (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%), a decline in the Federal Funds Rate signals further monetary easing, which supports equity valuations and produces positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5% and declining, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) rises above 9.5%, it signals a deepening labor market crisis, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
